grammarFocus: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达。
title: The Smart Speaker and the Privacy Puzzle
instructions: 这是一份模拟英语听力练习，适合B1–B2水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。注意：本材料为模拟练习，并非官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look worried. What's up?
Ben: Oh, hi Mia. It's my new smart speaker. I think it's great, but my sister says it's a privacy risk.
Mia: Really? What does she say?
Ben: She says that the speaker is always listening. She thinks that it records everything we say.
Mia: Well, that's not exactly true. Most smart speakers only start recording after they hear a wake word, like "Alexa" or "Hey Google".
Ben: That's what I thought. But my sister insists that the microphone is always on.
Mia: The microphone is on, yes, but it doesn't send data until it hears the wake word. At least, that's what the company says.
Ben: Hmm. But what if the speaker makes a mistake and records something private?
Mia: That can happen, but it's rare. You can check your privacy settings and delete recordings.
Ben: I didn't know that. How do I do that?
Mia: You can use the app. If you go to the settings menu, you'll see an option to review and delete your voice history.
Ben: OK, I'll try that. But my sister also says that the speaker could be hacked.
Mia: Any device connected to the internet can be hacked, but you can reduce the risk. For example, you should use a strong password and keep the software updated.
Ben: That makes sense. I'll update it tonight. But what about the data? Where does it go?
Mia: The company stores some data on its servers to improve the service. You can choose not to share some types of data.
Ben: So I can control what they collect?
Mia: Yes, to some extent. You can turn off some features, like personalized ads. But some basic data is always collected.
Ben: I see. So my sister is partly right, but not completely.
Mia: Exactly. It's good to be careful, but you don't need to be afraid of the speaker. Just learn how it works and adjust your settings.
Ben: Thanks, Mia. I feel better now. I'll talk to my sister and show her the privacy settings.
Mia: That's a good idea. And remember, if you have any doubts, you can always contact the company's support team.
Ben: I will. Thanks again!

questions.prompt: What is Ben's sister worried about?

The smart speaker is a privacy risk.
The smart speaker is difficult to use.
The smart speaker makes too much noise.
answers: The smart speaker is a privacy risk.
questions.explanation: Ben 说他的妹妹认为智能音箱有隐私风险。原文："my sister says it's a privacy risk."
questions.evidence: my sister says it's a privacy risk.

questions.prompt: According to Mia, when do most smart speakers start recording?
options: After they hear a wake word.
Only when you press a button.
When you connect them to the internet.
answers: After they hear a wake word.
questions.explanation: Mia 说大多数智能音箱只有在听到唤醒词后才开始录音。原文："Most smart speakers only start recording after they hear a wake word"
questions.evidence: Most smart speakers only start recording after they hear a wake word

questions.prompt: What does Ben's sister insist about the microphone?
options: It only works with the app.
questions.explanation: Ben 说他的妹妹坚持认为麦克风一直开着。原文："my sister insists that the microphone is always on."

questions.prompt: Mia says you can check your privacy settings and ______ recordings. (Use one word from the transcript.)
questions.explanation: Mia 说你可以检查隐私设置并删除录音。原文："You can check your privacy settings and delete recordings."
questions.evidence: You can check your privacy settings and delete recordings.

options: By using the app's settings menu.
answers: By using the app's settings menu.
questions.explanation: Mia 说可以通过应用程序的设置菜单来查看和删除语音历史。原文："If you go to the settings menu, you'll see an option to review and delete your voice history."
questions.evidence: If you go to the settings menu, you'll see an option to review and delete your voice history.

questions.prompt: What does Mia suggest to reduce the risk of hacking?

Not connecting it to the internet.

options: You can control all of it.
You can turn off some features but some basic data is always collected.

questions.evidence: You can turn off some features, like personalized ads. But some basic data is always collected.

grammar.title: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达
grammar.explanation: 名词性从句在句子中充当名词的角色，比如主语、宾语或表语。that 从句是常见的一种，由 that 引导，that 本身没有实际意义，只起连接作用。例如："She thinks that it records everything." 这里 that 从句作 thinks 的宾语。情态动词如 can, could, should, might 表示能力、可能性、建议等。条件表达常用 if 引导，表示“如果……”。例如："If you go to the settings menu, you'll see an option." 注意条件句的主句常用将来时，从句用一般现在时。
grammar.example: She thinks that it records everything we say.

options: He says that he will update the software.
He says that will he update the software.
He says he will update that the software.
He says that he update the software.
answers: He says that he will update the software.
questions.explanation: that 从句用陈述语序，且 that 后接完整句子。选项 A 正确。
questions.evidence: He says that he will update the software.

questions.prompt: If you ______ the app, you will see your voice history.
questions.explanation: if 条件句，主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时。所以用 open。
questions.evidence: If you open the app, you will see your voice history.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses a modal verb to give advice?
options: You should use a strong password.
You can use a strong password.
You might use a strong password.
You will use a strong password.
answers: You should use a strong password.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议。can 表示能力，might 表示可能性，will 表示将来。
questions.evidence: You should use a strong password.

questions.prompt: She insists that the microphone ______ always on.
questions.explanation: insist that 从句中通常用陈述语气，这里表示事实，用 is。
questions.evidence: She insists that the microphone is always on.
